verdicts.missing: The quote only says the methods "now take the optional iso_year argument" and does not name the DatabaseOperations methods. The 4.0 release notes do establish that this change is in 4.0, and an added optional argument is a signature change, so the core holds.

The quote says only that third-party backends may need changes. It does not say that projects using only built-in backends, or projects that neither override nor call these methods, are unaffected. It also says nothing about whether a project calls the methods.
